fields.reason: Samples HP26000001-HP26000005 are a two-letter prefix plus a sequential number, 72 distinct across 500 rows - an invoice identifier repeated across its lines.
Samples 1260101 and 1260102 are seven digits starting with 1, which is the CYYMMDD century marker for 2026.
Six-digit account numbers, 25 distinct; indistinguishable from the other account column in this file, so this is a guess on the lower value range.
Samples are business names like 'Cedar Grove Dining Group', 25 distinct - matching the 25 distinct account numbers.
Six-digit codes with 183 distinct values across 500 rows - item-level cardinality, with no manufacturer prefix.
Samples CPC-3559 and NVF-2017 carry a three-letter brand prefix and a dash, which is a manufacturer's own part format.
Only three distinct values (CPC, BLC, NVF) and they are the same prefixes that appear in the manufacturer part codes, so they identify the brand owner.
No clear vendor column; reusing the brand code as the vendor since both describe who supplied the line.
Small decimals like 9.00 and 3.00 with 27 distinct values, some negative - shipped quantities including credits.
Exactly three distinct values CS, LB and EA, which are already the canonical unit codes.
Small whole numbers 2, 4, 6, 24 and blank in a fifth of rows - a case multiplier that is absent for non-case items.
Empty in 80% of rows and a two-decimal weight like 105.36 in the rest - present only for variable-weight items.
Four-decimal values like 18.4100 with 179 distinct - per-unit pricing carried at more precision than the line total.
Two-decimal amounts with 485 distinct values, the highest cardinality of any numeric column, and 165.69 equals 9.00 x 18.41 on the first row.
Only Y and N, with N in 90% of rows - a flag, and the minority value co-occurs with a populated allowance price.
Empty in 90% of rows, four-decimal prices in the rest, and populated exactly where the Y flag appears.

ambiguities: customer_id: CUSTNO vs BILTNO - both are six-digit account numbers with 25 distinct values, the same 999999 shape, and both map one-to-one onto the customer name. Nothing in the samples distinguishes the bill-to from the ship-to; this needs the ERP's record layout.
invoice_vendor: no column clearly carries a vendor identity, so brand_manufacturer's column was reused with low confidence.
